docs.title: REBASH Academy
docs.text: Learn by Building.

docs.title: About REBASH Academy
docs.text: REBASH Academy is a production-grade documentation platform built for engineers who learn best by doing. We cover Linux, networking, containers, cloud platforms, CI/CD, security, and automation with hands-on labs, architecture diagrams, and real-world projects.

docs.title: Mission
docs.text:
Learn by Building.

We believe the fastest path to mastery is building real systems, breaking them, fixing them, and documenting what you learn along the way.

docs.title: What We Cover
docs.text: Category Topics Foundations Linux, Networking, Git Containers & Orchestration Docker, Kubernetes Infrastructure Terraform, AWS, Azure, GCP Delivery & Operations GitLab CI/CD, Monitoring Security DevSecOps, Cloud Security Automation Python, AI for DevOps

docs.title: Documentation Standards
docs.text:
Every tutorial on REBASH Academy follows a consistent structure:

  1. Overview – What you'll learn and why it matters
  2. Prerequisites – Required knowledge and tools
  3. Learning Objectives – Measurable outcomes
  4. Architecture Diagram – Visual system overview (Mermaid)
  5. Theory – Core concepts explained clearly
  6. Hands-on Lab – Step-by-step practical exercises
  7. Commands & Code – Copy-paste ready examples
  8. Common Mistakes – Pitfalls to avoid
  9. Best Practices – Production-ready recommendations
  10. Troubleshooting – Debug guide for common issues
  11. Summary – Key takeaways
  12. Interview Questions – Practice for technical interviews
  13. Related Tutorials – Continue your learning path
  14. References – Official docs and further reading

docs.title: Page Metadata
docs.text:
Each page includes:

  • Difficulty level (beginner / intermediate / advanced)
  • Estimated completion time
  • Author and last updated date
  • Prerequisites, category, and tags

docs.title: Technology
docs.text:
REBASH Academy is built with:

  • Material for MkDocs
  • Python 3.12+
  • Static site generation (no backend required)
  • GitHub Actions for CI/CD
  • GitHub Pages for hosting

docs.text: We welcome contributions! See CONTRIBUTING.md for guidelines on adding tutorials, fixing issues, and improving documentation.

  • Docker containerization path

The platform architecture supports future enhancements without structural changes:

docs.title: Learning Paths
docs.text: Choose a structured path based on your career goals. Each path builds on the previous sections and ends with production-ready projects.

docs.title: Primary Path – DevOps Engineer
docs.text:
The recommended path for engineers building a full-stack DevOps skill set:

flowchart TD
    A[Linux Engineer] --> B[Networking]
    B --> C[Git]
    C --> D[Docker]
    D --> E[Kubernetes]
    E --> F[Terraform]
    F --> G[Cloud]
    G --> H[CI/CD]
    H --> I[Monitoring]
    I --> J[Security]
    J --> K[Production Projects]
Step Section Description 1 Linux Command line, system admin, shell scripting 2 Networking TCP/IP, DNS, load balancing, troubleshooting 3 Git Version control and collaboration workflows 4 Docker Containerization fundamentals 5 Kubernetes Container orchestration at scale 6 Terraform Infrastructure as Code 7 Cloud AWS, Azure, or GCP specialization 8 GitLab CI/CD Pipeline automation and GitOps 9 Monitoring Observability and alerting 10 Security Hardening and compliance 11 Projects Portfolio-ready production projects
